verdict.rationale: Webhooks are a fair question for a cap-table SaaS platform, so the axis applies. The evidence pack has no documented, registrable outbound HTTP callbacks. The only notification evidence is Cake emailing your registered agent about share issuances, an adjacent feature rather than a programmatic webhook. The MCP integration is read-only query access, not event subscription, and the OpenAPI probes all returned 404.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can subscribe to events via webhooks
